a: A dragged key can land past `duration`, where the window can never show it
The held key selection is never checked against the tracks, though the segment selection is
Fold state is keyed by index path, so an external track insert or removal opens a different nested row
Inserting into an empty sampled track seeds a numeric `0` whatever the track's value type
A nested timeline's bar ignores where its parent stops playing it
b: Graph-mode lanes ignore the timeline's hold for tab order and focus attributes
An uncontrolled key selection survives track edits that move its index to another key; the segment selection beside it is dropped
Delete or Backspace with focus on the transport, the Graph switch or the inspector deletes the selected key
Key and segment marks on a nested row are named by track-local time, not the ruler time they sit at
